title: Rasigan
desc: Vijay and Anitha fall head over heels in love with each other, but are unable to express their feelings. When Anitha's father gets wind of it, he tries separating the couple.

title: Udan Pirappu
desc: Best friends Sathya and Viji are against selling their colony to a land grabber. Their friendship is put to the test after Viji falls in love with Sumathi and marries her.

title: Nadigan
desc: Desperate for money, a man poses as an elderly tutor for two young women. Later, he catches feelings for one of them while also wooing their guardian at the same time.

title: Vallinam
desc: Due to a fatal accident, Krishna, a basketball player, moves to a new college. There he locks horns with Vamsi, a cricket maniac, who does not let other sports gain importance.

title: Unnai Thedi
desc: Raghu travels to New Zealand with a friend and meets Malavika, whom he falls in love with. However, circumstances force them to part ways.
